# D2R Mobile · Diablo II: Resurrected for iPhone, iPad & Mac

**Play Diablo II: Resurrected offline on iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Mac.** Native ARM code, Metal graphics, touch controls and the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Bring your own Nintendo Switch game files.

**[Build & install](../README.md#getting-started)** · [Supported devices](../README.md#which-devices-are-supported) · [Releases](https://github.com/d2r-mobile/d2r-mobile/releases) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

## More time fighting. Less time sorting.

- **Touch controls:** drag to aim, tap to interact, double-tap to equip, long-press to sort. Connect a controller to use the original controller layout.
- **One-tap Runewords:** long-press a base and socket the required runes in one action.
- **Greater Rift:** 100 levels, timed clears, Rift Guardians and rewards. The skill cap rises from 20 to 40.
- **Boss Rush:** 12 stages, ending with Diablo Clone and the three Uber bosses.
- **Storage for collectors:** a searchable Chronicle for Unique and Set items, a wider stash, and runes, gems and crafting on one page.
- **English and Chinese:** switch the interface and voice acting in the game settings.

## Build it with one sentence

Have your game files ready, then tell Claude Code or Codex:

```text
Use the d2r-mobile skill from https://github.com/d2r-mobile/d2r-mobile to build D2R Mobile for my iPhone. My game files are in <path>.
```

The agent checks your machine, prepares the workspace, signs and installs the app, and copies your game resources. It asks for your Apple signing details and before an install that needs `sudo`.

| Where you want to play | Start here |
|---|---|
| iPhone or iPad | [Build and install](../README.md#getting-started); [check your device](../README.md#which-devices-are-supported) |
| Apple silicon Mac | [Build the native macOS app](../docs/MAC.md) |
| Packaging on Windows or Linux | [Use the shell and your own game files](../docs/NO_XCODE.md); signing and Linux verification status are listed in the guide |
| Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15) | [Community developer preview](../dm/tvos/README.md); verified through character selection, gameplay and saves remain unverified |
